title: papaver persicum subsp. tauricola
intro: Papaver persicum subsp. tauricola, commonly known as the "Tauric poppy," is a species of flowering plant in the poppy family (Papaveraceae). The Tauric poppy is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and soothing anxiety due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to act as an antispasmodic, analgesic, and anxiolytic. The bioactive constituents of Papaver persicum subsp. tauricola include alkaloids such as papaverine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
